q1_intentShape.type: src/types/campaign/CampaignSync.ts: a new ICampaignApplyGmInterventionIntent {kind: 'ApplyGmIntervention', campaignId, intentId, payload: {interventionId, summary, deltaCBills}} beside ICampaignReconcileBattleIntent, outside the guest-proposable ICampaignIntent union, plus a name for the host-command union (ICampaignIntent | ICampaignApplyGmInterventionIntent). Adding it to CampaignIntentKind instead would break the exhaustive switches in src/components/campaign/coop/pendingProposalFromWire.ts:86-107 (outside U92's paths) and would need campaignSyncSchemas.ts (outside U92's paths).
q1_intentShape.wire: src/types/multiplayer/Protocol.ts: CampaignApplyGmInterventionIntentSchema = {kind literal, campaignId min 1, intentId min 1, payload {interventionId min 1, summary trimmed min 1, deltaCBills z.number().int()}} added to CampaignHostIntentSchema's intent union (:518). z.number().int() refuses NaN, Infinity and fractions. The schema is not added to CampaignIntentSchema or GuestProposalSchema, so no guest path can parse the kind.
q1_intentShape.validate: one new arm in validateCampaignIntent (CampaignMatchHostIntent.ts), which takes the host-command union: the resulting balance must stay >= 0 (else reject 'insufficient-funds', the SpendFunds rule of :148-151), then FundsChanged {delta: deltaCBills, reason: summary, balance: state.balance + deltaCBills}. applyHostIntent / applyHostIntentLocked and the identity helpers take the same union, so the dedupe is the existing one by intentId (replayCommittedIntent before validation, intentCommandIdentity on commit). The binder needs no new branch: its generic arm (:828) carries the kind.
q1_intentShape.hostOnly: the existing binder check bindCampaignSyncConnection.ts:735-746 (every CampaignHostIntent from a player other than the entry's hostPlayerId is refused AUTH_REJECTED 'campaign-host-intent-requires-host') is the host-only check; the guest's other two doors cannot carry the kind (the guest intent path parses CampaignIntentSchema, CampaignMatchHost.doors.ts:115; a proposal parses GuestProposalSchema, CampaignGmArbiter.ts:290). A second host-only check in the validate arm would be unreachable (no caller can hand it a guest-authored ApplyGmIntervention), so none is added.
q1_intentShape.refusalCodes: a guest sender: Error AUTH_REJECTED reason 'campaign-host-intent-requires-host' (existing); a debit below zero: Error INVALID_INTENT reason 'insufficient-funds' (existing reason, the generic arm :845-866); a reused intentId over different work: INVALID_INTENT 'intent-identity-conflict' (existing); a frame that does not parse (no summary, a fractional delta): BAD_ENVELOPE 'malformed-envelope' (existing, :366-370). No new code or reason.

q2_transportAndWait.answer: A new module src/lib/campaign/coop/coopGmIntervention.ts: gmFundsInterventionIntent(campaign, updates) builds the intent from the approval's funds-transaction effect (the first funds-transaction effect in updates.gmInterventionEvents past the campaign's own list; deltaCBills = (after.balanceCents - before.balanceCents) / 100; summary = effect.publicSummary) or returns null; sendCoopGmIntervention(campaign, intent) takes the active host-role transport of the campaign's co-op match (getActiveCampaignSyncTransport, the coopHostTransport rule of dayActions.ts:338-345), sends the intent with sendHostIntent and resolves null on the FundsChanged event of the campaign whose delta and reason equal the intent's, or the reason (else code) of the Error frame carrying the intentId, or the message of a transport error or of a throwing send, or a fixed message when no host transport is active. Copied from sendAdvanceDay (dayActions.ts:380-431) because that helper is module-private in src/stores (outside U92's paths).
q2_transportAndWait.wait: no timeout, the same contract as U96's sendAdvanceDay (dayActions.ts:385): a timeout could not tell a lost answer from a slow commit, and reporting 'refused' for an intent the host later commits would invite a second approval that commits twice.
q2_transportAndWait.commitMatch: FundsChanged carries no intent id (CampaignSync.ts:208-215), so the commit is recognised by campaign, type, delta and reason; a concurrent FundsChanged with the same delta and summary (a second GM approval of the same correction racing the first) could resolve the first wait early. Recorded, not engineered around.
q2_transportAndWait.FN-u96-resent-advanceday-waits-without-t: not touched: this path never re-sends an intent (one send per approval, fresh intentId), so the deduped-resend-without-answer case does not arise here; the no-timeout wait on a lost answer is shared with the day advance.

q5_fold.answer: FundsChanged with reason = the intervention's public summary. There is no reason vocabulary: the fold reads only payload.balance (applyCampaignEvent.ts:80-83) and the feed prints reason as free text (campaignActivityProjection.ts:140-146); existing producers write free text ('Hired pilot <name>', CampaignMatchHostIntent.ts:181; the battle fundsReason). A literal 'gm-intervention' would put an internal token in the guest's feed instead of the public net effect coop-campaign-sync requires (spec.md:499-504), so the summary is used. The guest mirror and the host's fold apply it through applyCampaignEvent unchanged.

q6_codingDoctrine.fixAssessment: Root cause: no host command carries a signed GM C-bill change (SpendFunds debits only, campaignSyncSchemas.ts:78), and the ledger page's approve reaches only the local store and the whole-campaign save (gm-ledger.tsx:42-50). Fix: one host-only intent kind that rides the existing validate -> dedupe -> commit -> fan-out door as FundsChanged, and the page sends it for a co-op funds approval instead of writing the store.

risksForTheParent: Authority (Lane B): in co-op the GM's funds approval now round-trips through the live host as a host-only command; a tester sees the balance move only after the host commits (a short delay), and a refusal (debit below zero, host unavailable) shows as an error toast with nothing applied.

Authority: the host's own local store is no longer written by a co-op funds approval; the balance arrives by re-reading the record the command rewrote. The approval's transaction row and its gmInterventionEvents entry are therefore not persisted for a co-op campaign (the owner's default 'no separate local-store write'); the host's GM ledger lists the approval only in the component-local rows until the page reloads.

Authority: the gm-ledger page mounts no co-op transport of its own (campaignPageShell.tsx:357-362); a GM who opens or reloads the ledger page directly, before visiting a page that connects the host transport (the dashboard), has no active host transport and the approval is refused with 'no live host connection'.

Idempotency (Lane B): each approval carries a fresh interventionId and intentId, so two approvals of the same canned correction commit twice (the unit's intent). The approve button is not disabled while the round trip is in flight (GmCampaignInterventionActions.tsx:134-135, src/components), so a double click during the round trip is two approvals and commits twice; on the baseline the same double click wrote the same absolute balance twice.
Idempotency: the commit is recognised by delta and summary (FundsChanged carries no intent id); two identical approvals in flight at once could each resolve on the other's event.
Privacy: the guest's frame carries delta, reason (the public summary) and balance only; the private metadata (helpers.ts:94-101) never enters the command.
